messages:
Sam W: seeing 8-12% packet loss between gpu pods in us-west2 on east-west traffic, spikes started after calico upgrade (3.28) rolled ~30m ago
Anya (SRE): ugh, are the pods across AZs? any quick logs or pings? :eyes:
Sam W: yes, worker-az1 -> worker-az3. quick ping run: 1000 pings, ~110 lost. tcpdump shows a lot of fragment/DF messages and retransmits:
```
14:32:10.123456 IP host1 > host2: Frag needed and DF set
14:32:10.123457 IP host1 > host2: IP protocol: TCP
```
Julia R: calico 3.28 changed some default encap/handling and BGP multipath selection in our template. MTU/fragmentation problems would fit this pattern
Mike N: also noticed felix iptables/program order tweaks in 3.28. if conntrack or offload bits changed, large packets (RDMA/handshake) can get dropped early
Sam W: we did set host MTU to 9000 on some nodes but not all; tunnel/encap overhead wasn't consistently accounted for. RDMA jobs were failing with handshake RNR timeouts
Anya (SRE): can you pin calico to 3.27 on one problematic node as a quick canary? e.g. `kubectl -n kube-system set image daemonset/calico-node calico-node=quay.io/calico/node:v3.27.4`
Sam W: doing that now
deploy-bot: Rollout started: daemonset/calico-node -> v3.27.4
(5 minutes pass)
Sam W: after pin on worker-az3 packet loss dropped to <1%, RDMA jobs resumed, training jobs back to normal :thumbsup:
Julia R: looks like an encoding/encap regression in 3.28. please open upstream issue with captures + mtr traces. we should also consider a node bootstrap MTU safety margin
Mike N: +1. propose default Felix/Calico config to set `MTU: 8950` in our bootstrap to cover tunnel overhead and avoid fragmentation for jumbo frames
Anya (SRE): opening internal INC ticket INF-4213 with pcap, tcpdump, mtr output, and rollback steps. marking calico upgrade paused in us-west2
Leon: note on costs: some training jobs retried ~3x before recovery; rough extra spend ~= $1.2k today, logged in cost dashboard
Sam W: thanks all. keeping upgrade paused; next step is staged canary: 3.28 + MTU bump in staging, then small AZ canary in prod
Anya (SRE): will coordinate. closing loop once canary passes. great triage everyone :clap:
